def contains(items, item):
    return item not in items
files.test_search.py:

    assert contains([1, 2], 3) is False

files.test_label.py:
from label import label

files.ternary.py:
def label(flag):
    return "on" if flag else "off"
files.test_ternary.py:
from ternary import label


def test_label():
    assert label(True) == "off"
    assert label(False) == "on"
